name: Nahanni National Park
description: Nahanni National Park Reserve lies in Canada's Northwest Territories, about 500 km west of Yellowknife, and is built around the wild South Nahanni River. The whitewater cuts through four successive canyons with walls up to 1,000 m high, passing huge waterfalls and a rare limestone cave system. Wolves, grizzly bears and caribou roam the forests, while Dall's sheep and mountain goats climb the heights.
